1.consolidated_definition: Determinado, dinámico, emprendedor. Se dice de la persona determinada a conseguir lo que se propone; también del proyecto o plan que aspira a ser un éxito. Desvío semántico, usual. DRAE 2001: que tiene ambición. El alcalde Jorge Santini presentó hoy un ambicioso plan para la zona sur de la Capital que incluye el desarrollo del San Juan Bayside, que describio como el edificio mas grande de Puerto Rico (AOL people connection, 08-08-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Determined, dynamic, entrepreneurial. Said of a person determined to achieve their goals; also of a project or plan aspiring to be successful. Semantic shift, common. DRAE 2001: having ambition.

The mayor Jorge Santini presented today an ambitious plan for the southern zone of the Capital that includes the development of San Juan Bayside, which he described as the largest building in Puerto Rico (AOL people connection, 08-08-08)

Note: I translated "Capital" to maintain the original context and avoid specifying a particular city. If you want me to translate it to a specific city, please let me know.

Also, I kept "San Juan Bayside" as is, assuming it's a proper noun referring to a specific location in Puerto Rico. If you need further clarification or translation, please provide more context.
